name: Eshton
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Eshton is a person mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Mehir and the father of Beth-Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. He is primarily known through genealogical records and plays a role in establishing family lines within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Eshton is listed as the son of Mehir in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, as part of a detailed genealogical overview.

keyEvents.title: Father of Beth-Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah
keyEvents.description: Eshton is mentioned as the father of Beth-Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah, founder of Ir-Nachash. These descendants contributed to establishing settlements in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Part of the lineage of Kelab
keyEvents.description: Eshton belongs to the broader lineage of Kelab, which is an important branch within the tribe of Judah and connected to several significant families.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: As part of Judah's genealogy, Eshton represents a key connecting line in the tribe that would later lead to King David and the messianic line.
